SKU: J.26.SNM.STR.XX.149.1

View full details

The team-trusted freerider

Ideal for creative lines and dynamic descents

Freeride by shape but all-mountain by nature, the Stratos is our Pro Team’s number one daily driver from storm cycles to spring sessions. On deep days it floats like a dedicated powder craft, but its short sidecut and lively flex are full of dynamic energy to stay out long after the mountain’s tracked. Proven from backcountry descents to banked slaloms podiums, there’s always a new line to ride when you’re on the Stratos.

The board of choice for:

Antti Autti

Harry Kearney

Ruiki Masuda

Details

Shape & profile

[Shape]

Directional

A directional outline with a longer nose, shorter tail and setback stance to optimize float, maneuverability and edge power. Designed for riders who prioritize performance on groomers and in the backcountry over park riding.

[Pr0file]

Freeride CamRock

Versatile freeride profile featuring camber underfoot with an extended nose rocker and shorter tail rocker. This generates powerful edge hold, precise response and confidence at speed, combined with exceptional float and maneuverability in powder.

[Tracti0n_tech]

High Traction Tech

High Traction Tech features three bumps per edge (front binding, board center, back binding). The middle bump is bigger than the outside bumps for better grip and control.

[Taper]

Medium Tapered

A sweet-spot for directional shapes that need to float in powder but still hold their own across variable snow and terrain. Nimble in deep snow, precise on piste and versatile enough to handle a full day on the mountain. Any shape with 10–15mm of taper between the nose and tail.

3D Contour Base

Surf-inspired shaping for next-level performance.

Inspired by the rounded bottom contours of surfboards, 3D Contour Bases are designed to make every run smoother and every turn more effortless by reducing the drag of the board tips. 3D Contour Bases enhance glide and improve float, helping you ride faster and with better flow. Learn more

[3d_pr0file]

High 3D Contour Base

Freeride-focused 3D Contour Base featuring 4-8mm of spoon bevel in the nose and 0-7mm of spoon bevel in the tail. Spoon bevel starts just before the contact points.

How it works

Riding flat

When riding flat, the spoon bevel on the edges is not engaged, but it does help smoothly deflect snow away from the nose of the board.

Turn initiation

As you begin to make a turn, the spoon bevel helps you smoothly roll the board on to your egde with less friction and edge drag.

Mid turn

In the middle of a turn, camber and Traction Tech keep you locked onto your egde in the center of the board while the spoon bevel reduces the "plow effect" of your nose and tail edges.

Features & construction

All of our adult boards are built using high-quality materials and innovative tech in a Fair Trade Certified™ factory powered by 100% solar energy. Learn more by checking out our Materials Library

[Base]

Flip-Flop Base

Jones models with Flip-Flop bases are made in two base colorways to minimize P-Tex waste. Orders may be filled with either color and color does not vary by size.

Sintered 8000 Base

Premium sintered base material that’s ultra fast, highly wax absorbent, easy to repair and proven to be one of the most durable and long lasting base materials in the industry.

Wend Natural Wax

All Jones snowboards come factory waxed with WEND natural wax so they’re ready to shred straight out of the shop.

[Fibers]

Biax Fiberglass

Biaxial fiberglass laminate made with a dual-layer, dual-directional construction that delivers a forgiving yet snappy board feel with a mid-soft torsional flex and quick energy transfer.

[Stringer]

ampliTex™ Carbon / Flax Stringers

Hybrid performance stringers made from carbon and naturally sourced flax fiber, developed with Swiss engineering firm Bcomp®.

[T0psheet]

Premium Topsheet

Durable and scratch resistant premium topsheet engineered to endure rigorous daily use in extreme conditions.

[Resin]

Bio Resin

A bio-based epoxy made with 27% plant-based carbon that reduces CO₂ emissions by 33% compared to conventional petroleum-based epoxy. Sourced from plant-based industrial by-products, its unmatched bonding properties deliver industry leading durability and performance.

[Edges]

Recycled ABS

Recycled ABS sidewalls with a rounded finish that are engineered to enhance durability by reducing topsheet chipping and impact damage.

Recycled edges

Bombproof steel edges made from recycled German steel, engineered for maximum strength and long-lasting durability.

[C0re]

Power Core

Advanced triple-density full wood core made from responsibly harvested Bamboo, Paulownia and Poplar. Centered Bamboo stringers enhance durability, pop and torsional stiffness, while the Paulownia keeps the core light and damp.

Jones Snowboards Customer Service

S
Stefan
Super friendly, reliable, versatile, smooth board that supports progress without being punishing.

I got into skiing after decades of skiing so this may not be the usual review.

I went to snowboard tests looking for a board that would pull my technique upwards. My short list based on reviews and tests was Jones Frontier and Mind Expander. Trying those first I totally loved how comfortable and easy they seemed but did not feel like I was getting challenged in any way. I think that skiing stiff groomer skis got me used to a certain feeling under my feet, a feeling that I am also seeking in boards. So the specialists at the Jones stand told me that I may try some stiffer boards and I got to test the Flagship and the Stratos. That was the exact feeling under foot that I was looking for: stable, reliable, dump, aggressive, while at the same time playful and not at all punishing.

So I ordered the Jones Stratos, which I perceived as more playful and now had it for about a month. The board is beyond expectations. Not only that it is playful and versatile but it actually corrects technique mistakes due to its strong, reliable tail and fantastic grip on ice. It does short, medium and long turns with ease, slow or high speed equally well, carves on groomers like a dream, and there doesn’t seem to be a limit to how aggressive it can be, while at the same time enjoying a relaxed, casual ride, if so wanted. I tested it in powder, too, approx. 30-40cm of fresh snow and I did not move the bindings towards the back at all and still floated very nicely, no nose dive at all.

Hey Stefan,
This is an incredible review – thanks for taking the time to share your experience!
Love that you found exactly what you were looking for. The Stratos delivers that stable, aggressive feel while staying playful and forgiving – sounds like it's pulling your riding exactly where you want it to go.
Stoked to have you riding Jones!
Artur
Jones Snowboards Customer Service

Stratos 159
